lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits. The pattern consists of at least three distinct horizontal rows: a superior row of large, widely spaced blobs; a medial row of regularly spaced, medium-sized blobs; and an inferior row of smaller, more densely clustered spots extending toward the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible traversing the flank, intersecting with the horizontal rows of circular blobs to create high-contrast anchor nodes at the junction points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, each defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient, with light-saturated upper edges and shadowed lower margins running parallel to the dorsal-lateral transition.
